INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images. For the image tool, omit referenced_image_paths and num_last_images_to_include.

SOURCE: Mightyena (그라에나), dark type.

PALETTE: gray, black.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime-mecha promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized hard-surface detail. Match the face and armor at the same polished rendering intensity.

SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Mightyena as her motif — the creature reimagined as an armored adult woman, not a mascot costume or a creature suit: her plates, undersuit, hair and ornaments carry its palette, markings and shapes. She wears its features as costume; nothing is carried, mounted or put on display. Her skin is human skin.

WEAR: the diamond-shaped ears become a headpiece or hair ornament of the same shape; the black shaggy tail becomes a long sash hanging from the back of her belt, in the same shape and colors; its markings (dark triangular eye markings) become painted lines and patterns on her plates and undersuit.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): elongated face, long length, narrow width; long chin with defined jaw; sharp eyes, medium size, level outer corners, wide-set; thick low brows; balanced nose; wide mouth.

FORM — LIGHT: one close-fitting armor layer: slim plates at the shoulders, forearms, hips and shins over a fitted undersuit, joints free, a slim readable outline. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that is also this form's card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

Chosen settings below override the default stance and camera; her identity and form stay fixed.

Note: One adult human woman, face toward camera, both hands completely visible with one thumb and four separated fingers each; hands relaxed open away from body. No handheld items or weapons.

hair color: black
